source: General AP-style rules shared by every project. A project adds its own house terms in a file of the same format named by its brand profile ("terminology": "house-terms.json"); its sets merge into these and its audience sets load only with that audience profile.
note: Every finding is a WARN [TERM_BRAND] with the preferred term. Rule kinds: case (exact capitalization of a word, e.g. a product name), regex (pattern + suggest, or suggest_template), midsentence (lowercase unless it starts a sentence), apdate (AP month abbreviations). A project file may also add "jargon" {term: plain alternative} and "acronyms" {ACRONYM: spelled out}.

internal.why: AP dates: abbreviate Jan., Feb., Aug., Sept., Oct., Nov., Dec.; no ordinals
